name: draw-and-play
description: Web-based tournament software with planner, live forecast and browser-based result entry

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@draw-and-play/server & npm run dev --workspace=@draw-and-play/web & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@draw-and-play/web && npm run build --workspace=@draw-and-play/server
scripts.e2e: docker run --rm --network host --ipc host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD":/repo -w /repo mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble node e2e/walkthrough.mjs
